_readme: Marsad parallel (black) market rate. Edit usdLyd, updated and sources, then redeploy. Set usdLyd to null when you have no verified figure - the app and site hide the section rather than show a number nobody has checked. NOTE: 'note' is deliberately a single space. The shipped app falls back to its built-in 'unofficial estimate' disclaimer whenever note is empty, so a space is the only way to suppress that line without an App Store release. Put real text here any time and it will show instead.
